detail.longDescription: It feels like it was only last week when spotting an AI-generated video was easy peasy. All you had to do was look for the very obvious tells—like when a dog spawned a mysterious fifth limb mid-run or crowds of people walked through an otherwise lively city like they were loading in (it's exactly as unnerving an image as you're picturing).
